Condition: Policy review/approval evidence is not consistently retained
Criteria: Policies should be reviewed and approved through a controlled process
Impact: Staff may rely on outdated guidance
Recommendation: Implement annual policy review workflow with approval record and version history

Condition: No documented periodic threat-intelligence review exists
Criteria: Threat intelligence should support timely identification of relevant threats
Impact: Emerging threats may not be considered in risk decisions
Recommendation: Define sources owner cadence and review record

Condition: Quarterly access recertification is not consistently evidenced
Criteria: Access rights should be reviewed according to business need
Cause: Review process lacks consistent evidence retention
Recommendation: Run quarterly access certification with approval and exception tracking

Condition: Critical suppliers do not consistently receive risk-based security due diligence
Criteria: Supplier controls should reflect supplier security risk
Cause: Criticality criteria and minimum evidence are not standardized
Impact: Third-party compromise may introduce security/privacy exposure
Recommendation: Implement vendor tiering questionnaire evidence requirements and reassessment

Condition: Cloud control ownership is not fully documented
Criteria: Cloud-service security responsibilities should be understood and managed
Impact: Control gaps may be missed between provider and customer
Recommendation: Create cloud control ownership matrix and review it annually

Condition: RTO/RPO mapping and restore-test evidence are incomplete
Criteria: ICT readiness should support continuity objectives
Cause: Recovery requirements are not consistently linked to technical tests
Impact: Recovery may not meet business expectations
Recommendation: Document RTO/RPO by critical service and perform restore testing

Condition: Vulnerability remediation ageing and risk exceptions are inconsistently tracked
Criteria: Vulnerabilities should be assessed and addressed according to risk
Recommendation: Implement severity-based remediation SLA and risk-acceptance workflow

Condition: Logging coverage and retention are not formally mapped
Criteria: Relevant security events should be logged and protected
Recommendation: Create logging-source matrix with owner and retention requirement
